title: Lanyard identification badge
slide_intent: Identify a person and their institution together because access objects are also interpersonal introductions.
strategic_value: An enlarged symbol can make a badge recognizable before its smaller text is read.
demonstration: A clear badge holder on a dark lanyard contains a white card with large black monogram strokes and small text.
practical_value: Evaluate the scale relationship between identity and personal information on a worn object.
